accept_limit: max 2 pinholes under 0.5 mm outside the sealing face; none on the sealing face
rework_action: Grind the pinhole area flush; fill with approved epoxy if under 1 mm deep; scrap if any pinhole is on the sealing face

accept_limit: no visible shrinkage cavity on machined faces
rework_action: Mark the cavity; send to weld repair; re-machine and re-inspect
